scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names contracts,auth,web,desktop --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build --watch" "pnpm --filter @velin/auth-server dev" "pnpm --filter @velin/auth-web dev" "vite"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && pnpm --filter @velin/auth-web build && pnpm --filter @velin/auth-server build && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && pnpm --filter @velin/auth-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @velin/auth-server typecheck && tsc -b
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @velin/auth-server test
scripts.format: prettier --write src electron apps/*/src packages/*/src tests apps/auth-server/tests docs AGENTS.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src electron apps/*/src packages/*/src tests apps/auth-server/tests docs AGENTS.md README.md
